- get: check for existence; if expired → remove and return default. On hit → move_to_end.
- put: first drop expired ones, then insert/update with move_to_end, and evict LRU while len > capacity.
- __len__: remove expired ones and return len.
- __contains__: check for key existence and non-expiration; don't change access order. Maybe should remove expired ones too? Not required but no problem — removing inside __contains__ is fine. The spec says "expired entries are removed" on get. For `in`, it's True only if live. Removing expired ones here is harmless. Note: __contains__ should not change access order — move_to_end is only on hit.

Edge case: ttl could be 0? In that case, always expired (clock() >= t + 0 → if clock is monotonic, clock() >= t is likely to be true at the time of put; in tests clock is fake and t doesn't advance: expired when clk() >= t, which is true even at equality). ttl=0 → entry expires immediately. No problem.

", "t": [["write_file", "{"path":"D:\\Projects\\local_ai\\strata-lab\\runs\\work\\hermes\\lru_ttl-1794053108\\lru_ttl.py","content":"import time\nfrom collections import OrderedDict\n\n\nclass LRUCache:\n    def __init__(self, capacity, ttl=None, clock=time.monotonic):\n        if capacity < 1:\n            raise ValueError(\"capacity must be at least 1\")\n        self.capacity = capacity\n        self.ttl = ttl\n        self.clock = clock\n        # key -> (value, expires_at) where expires_at is None when ttl is None\n        self._data = OrderedDict()\n\n    def _expired(self, expires_at):\n        return expires_at is not None and self.clock() >= expires_at\n\n    def _drop_expired(self):\n        if self.ttl is None:\n            return\n        now = self.clock()\n        dead = [k for k, (_, exp) in self._data.items() if now >= exp]\n        for k in dead:\n            del self._data[k]\n\n    def get(self, key, default=None):\n        entry = self._data.get(key)\n        if entry is None:\n            return default\n        value, expires_at = entry\n        if self._expired(expires_at):\n            del self._data[key]\n            return default\n        self._data.move_to_end(key)\n        return value\n\n    def put(self, key, value):\n        self._drop_expired()\n        expires_at = None if self.ttl is None else self.clock() + self.ttl\n        self._data[key] = (value, expires_at)\n        self._data.move_to_end(key)\n        while len(self._data) > self.capacity:\n            self._data.popitem(last=False)\n\n    def __len__(self):\n        self._drop_expired()\n        return len(self._data)\n\n    def __contains__(self, key):\n        entry = self._data.get(key)\n        if entry is None:\n            return False\n        if self._expired(entry[1]):\n            del self._data[key]\n            return False\n        return True\n"}"]]}
